subject.title: [Feature]: Expose Discord slash interaction response controls to plugin commands

question: Should plugin command responders be exposed as a generic plugin-command/channel capability or as a Discord-specific `ctx.discord.respond` surface?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the permanent SDK shape determines whether OpenClaw adds a reusable command responder contract or a channel-specific escape hatch in a public plugin API.

options.title: Add generic responder capability
options.body: Define a narrow documented command responder/capability that Discord implements first and other native-command channels can adopt later.

options.title: Add Discord-specific context
options.body: Expose `ctx.discord.respond` for the immediate Discord use case, accepting a channel-specific public SDK surface.

options.title: Decline SDK expansion
options.body: Keep plugin commands on returned `ReplyPayload` only and require plugin authors to build external Discord-specific workarounds.

recommendation.title: Add generic responder capability
recommendation.body: Define a narrow documented command responder/capability that Discord implements first and other native-command channels can adopt later.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision is primarily a public plugin SDK boundary choice, and steipete is tied to both the original plugin command merge and later plugin-boundary refactor history.
